forms.gloss: to form a ridge around a field
field with ridges, lands divided into beds to admit and retain water for cultivation of paddy
to make a ridge along the boundary

records.raw_entry_text: S21 Ta. accu ridge in a field; accu-kkattu (-kkatti-) to form a ridge around a field; accukkattu field with ridges, lands divided into beds to admit and retain water for the cultivation of paddy. Te. (inscr.) accu kaṭṭu seyu to make a ridge along the boundary.

forms.gloss: leaf, blade; plate made of sewn-up leaves
forms.source_detail: so Hahn, Tiga; Grignard's form probably mistaken

forms.gloss: to divine by looking at a leaf

records.raw_entry_text: S22 Kur. atkha (so Hahn, Tiga; Grignard's atkha is probably mistaken) leaf, blade, (Grignard also) plate made of sewn-up leaves. Malt. Atge leaf, palm of the hand; Atgen ere to divine by looking at a leaf; atgo a diviner. [Delete both from 54.] (Pfeiffer.) ? Cf. 284 Ka. aku.
S23 Pa. arṇi- to cross; arṇip- (arṇit-) to make to cross. Go. (SR. W. Ph.) ahkana, (Tr.) ahakana to cross, pass over; (Mu.) ahk garm on the other side (Voc. 112).
S24 Go. (Ph.) anai much (Voc. 130). Pe. anay much.
S25 Ta. aṭu (aṭi-) to rub, besmear (as sandal paste). Malt. aḍe to bedaub, deface.
S26 Ta. ār (-pp-, -tt-) to fight, make war; ārppu battle. Kol. (SR) arpalipeṇ to attack. (Kamaleswaran.)
S27 Ta. ikulai woman's confidante; kindred, friendship. Kuwi (Mah.) iguya mother's younger sister; iguva father's younger brother.
S28 Kol. (Kin.) irp wall. Go. (Mu.) ḍipi mud-wall (Voc. 1566). (Kamaleswaran.)
S29 Ta. iru great, spacious, vast. Te. inu, in: inumikkili very much, very great.
S29A Ta. ivuli horse. Br. hulli id. (Burrow 1972).

forms.gloss: smoke used to drive out or kill an animal or to ripen fruit

records.raw_entry_text: S210 Ka. (Tiptur, LSB 18.16) udra smoke to drive off mosquitoes. Te. uidara smoke used to drive out or kill an animal or to ripen fruit.

forms.gloss: to remove the outer envelope from a fruit; clean and trim vegetables

records.raw_entry_text: S211 Kur. endekhna, endkha'ana to remove the outer envelope from a fruit, clean and trim vegetables. Malt. engde to clear away weeds. (Pfeiffer.)
S212 Go. (Ko.) erek, (Ma.) reki leaf umbrella; (G.) reki, (Elwin) rek leaf hat (Voc. 3044). Kuwi (F.) jekki a leaf hat (jappi).

forms.gloss: the other, the other one, the second

records.comparison_or_correction_text: Kamaleswaran, with opposition to derivation of Ta. eṇai from eṇ ‘why?’.
records.raw_entry_text: S213 Ta. eṇai other, the rest. Br. loḍ the other, the other one, the second. (Kamaleswaran, with opposition to derivation of Ta. eṇai from eṇ why?).
S214 Ma. (Tiyya) kataru khadi. Tu. kadale a rag. Go. (Mu.) gatla, (G.) getli, (Ma.) getla, gette, (L.) gete, gende cloth (Voc. 1175).

records.comparison_or_correction_text: goli ‘jackal’ is IA; ? Br. kharma ‘wolf’; [delete from 935]. (Kamaleswaran.)
records.raw_entry_text: S214A Pa. garum goli fox (goli jackal < IA). ? Br. kharma wolf; [delete from 935]. (Kamaleswaran.)

records.comparison_or_correction_text: ? Te. kaluva id., ceṉgaluva the red water lily.
records.raw_entry_text: S215 Ta. karunīr, ceṉ-karunīr water lily. Ma. ceṉ-karinīr id. ? Te. kaluva id., ceṉgaluva the red water lily.

forms.gloss: state of being an envious person, envy

records.raw_entry_text: S216 Ka. karumbu, karubu to envy; n. envy; karuba an envious man; fem. karubi; karubatana state of being an envious person, envy. ? Go. (Ch.) karvitana, (W.) karwītana to envy.
S217 Pa. kipra a snail's shell. Pe. kipri shell (of snail, etc.); skull. Mand. kirpa shell. Kuwi (Mah.) kirpa skull.
S218 Pa. kukondi, (S.) kukandi leopard. Go. (Koya Su.) kukkal id.

forms.gloss: a lock or tuft of hair; crest of peacock

records.raw_entry_text: S219 Te. kunkati, kukati a lock or tuft of hair, (SAN also) crest of peacock. Go. (Ma.) kukur(i), (Ko.) kukur cock's comb (Voc. 712); (Koya Su.) kukod, (A. Su.) kokkōr id.; (LuS.) kookooree crest on a bird's head. Konda (B.) kukuti hair. [Delete Te. and Konda in DEDS 1361].
records.extractor_notes: LuS form is retained in raw text but not separately normalized due to unclear glyphs

records.raw_entry_text: S220 Go. (Ph.) kuṭar chaff (Voc. 729); (A Su.) kuṭṭar corn without grains. Kur. (Hahn) kuṭṭa chaff.

forms.gloss: to chop off, cut down, slaughter, bruise
forms.source_detail: Bray's Br. gud-; queried comparison with Sindhi is rejected as hardly relevant

records.comparison_or_correction_text: Bray: Bal. gud-, presumably borrowed from Br.; queried comparison with Sindhi gud-, now expanded to Turner CDIAL 3934(6) Sindhi gudaṇu ‘to pound, thrash’, Panjabi guddna ‘to beat, pelt, hoe, weed’, hardly seems relevant except possibly Br. ‘to bruise’. (Kamaleswaran.)
records.raw_entry_text: S221 Kol. (SR) gudipeṇ to cut crops or grass. Br. gud-ding to chop off, cut down, slaughter, bruise; (Bray: Bal. gud-, presumably as borrowed from Br.; his queried comparison with Sindhi gud-, now to be expanded to Turner, CDIAL, no. 3934(6) Sindhi gudaṇu to pound, thrash, Panjabi guddna to beat, pelt, hoe, weed, hardly seems relevant, except possibly for the Br. meaning to bruise). (Kamaleswaran.)
S222 Ta. kuṭirai lock of a gun. Ka. kudure id. Tu. kudūr id.; (B-K) id., catch of an umbrella.
S223 Ta. kuyil, kuyiṉ cloud. Go. (Tr.) kuhkar fog, mist (Voc. 817); (Mu.) guhra sky, cloud (Voc. 1169). Kui kutu kueri mist, fog.

forms.gloss: to loosen a stone by scratching or digging with the nails

records.raw_entry_text: S224 Ka. gebaru to scratch, as the ground; gebbu id., loosen a stone, etc. by scratching or digging with the nails. Go. (S.) giv- (dog) to scratch up earth (Voc. 1092) [delete from DEDS 1316]; (Koya T.) givv- to scratch.
S225 Te. gede a she-buffalo. Konda geyda id. Kuwi (F.) gedde id.
S226 Ta. kaivaram encomium; kaivari panegyrist. Te. kaivaramu praise, encomium, flattery.
S227 Go. (SR.) kopa small earthen vessel; (Tr.) kōpa small earthen pot (Voc. 906).
